title: Facebook (FB) Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Facebook value and a fiscal trading framework.
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

claims.reason: The 2020 co-movement is observable, and the author correctly notes chart-axis alignment exaggerates similarity. Common liquidity shocks can move both series; a two-axis chart does not establish inflation expectations as the independent cause.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: June 2020 Monetary Policy Report, part 2
evidence.finding: Investors sold longer Treasuries and MBS for liquid assets; Treasury bid-ask spreads widened and dealer balance-sheet constraints impaired intermediation. Purchases and lending aimed to restore market function.

claims.reason: Transfers supported income, but an on/off fiscal label ignores ongoing deficits, emergency programs and savings buffers. Conditional future insolvency is not established merely by reduced transfer growth.

evidence.finding: Personal income fell 4.2% in May after revised 10.8% growth in April. Declining recovery payments explained much of the decrease, partly offset by unemployment benefits. Spending rose 8.2%.

evidence.finding: Contemporary estimate: Q3 2020 real GDP +33.4% annualized, Q4 +4.1%. There was no renewed quarterly contraction in the second half of 2020.

framework_lessons: Risk recognition can coexist with a good investment.
assessment: Facebook was a successful long-window selection and its conservative initial EPS growth was surpassed. The analysis usefully identified privacy sensitivity, but its assertion that buybacks had not begun was wrong. The comparison also underestimated Cadence growth. Fiscal timing and the proposed technical entry rule remain less auditable than the company forecast.
verification_limitations: Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.

Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
